input.summary: Fix illusory cap basis: greater of 12 months' fees under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap currently keys to "Fees", defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so it is illusory. We have moved it to our position: the greater of fees paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remaining outside the cap.

ops.oldText: the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
